summary: Binda–Kato–Vezzani prove the p-adic weight–monodromy conjecture for scheme-theoretic complete intersections in projective smooth toric varieties, by tilting to equal characteristic through log motives and a motivic Hyodo–Kato realization (with a comparison to Große-Klönne's, Corollary 3.13). Complete (cc-442dc5): every numbered statement is an item, every missing item is routed, and fourteen findings are recorded against arXiv v2. After review the definitional slips E2, E3, E6, E8 and E12 affect nothing; E10, E13 and the cited AGV erratum (E14) remain. Not formalised.

items.name: Quasicategory carrier
items.statement: A simplicial set is a quasicategory when every inner horn has a filler. The pinned class supplies this carrier, not stable presentable infinity-categories or monoidal localizations.
items.note: Only this exact elementary carrier/lemma is in the pinned baseline; the enhanced geometric comparison remains a separate item.

uses.how: Uses quasicategory carrier in stable presentable rational enhancement.

items.name: Ordinary derived category
items.statement: For an abelian category with the indicated localization universe, DerivedCategory is the category of cochain complexes localized at quasi-isomorphisms. It is an ordinary category, not the required enhanced derived category.
items.note: Only this exact elementary carrier/lemma is in the pinned baseline; the enhanced geometric comparison remains a separate item.

uses.how: Uses ordinary derived category in stable presentable rational enhancement.

items.name: Fontaine theta map
items.statement: For a p-adically complete separated commutative ring R with p prime and nonunit, the pinned ring homomorphism theta:W(R-flat)→R is the inverse limit of its reductions modulo p-powers; theta([x])=x-sharp.
items.note: Only this exact elementary carrier/lemma is in the pinned baseline; the enhanced geometric comparison remains a separate item.

Uses fontaine theta map in perfectoid tilting and tower foundations.

items.name: Theta on Teichmüller representatives
items.statement: Under the assumptions of theta, the Teichmüller representative of x in the tilt maps to its multiplicative untilt x-sharp.
items.note: Only this exact elementary carrier/lemma is in the pinned baseline; the enhanced geometric comparison remains a separate item.

items.name: Witt-vector isocrystal
items.statement: For a perfect characteristic-p field k, an isocrystal on a W(k)[1/p]-vector space carries a bijective Frobenius-semilinear automorphism. The pinned class does not include monodromy or the geometric realization.
items.note: Only this exact elementary carrier/lemma is in the pinned baseline; the enhanced geometric comparison remains a separate item.

items.name: Finite fan of lattice cones
items.statement: For an integral lattice map N→V into a real vector space, a fan is a finite collection of toric cones closed under faces, with each pairwise intersection a face of both. This is only the combinatorial carrier.
items.note: Only this exact elementary carrier/lemma is in the pinned baseline; the enhanced geometric comparison remains a separate item.

items.statement: A log formal scheme here has an adic underlying formal scheme of finite ideal type and an integral quasi-coherent log structure on its small étale site. Fine means locally finitely generated integral charts; the valuation-log bases need not be fine.

items.name: Log smoothness by finite chart models
items.statement: A map over an integral quasi-coherent log (formal) base is log smooth if locally it is obtained by base change from a log-smooth map between fine log (formal) schemes. Preserve the étale topology and adic finite-ideal-type conditions.

items.name: Finite-chart approximation of log-smooth maps
items.statement: For a morphism X→X' between log-smooth objects over an integral quasi-coherent log base S, étale locally on X,X',S there is a fine log structure M0→M_S and a log-smooth morphism over (S,M0) whose pullback is the given map. Finite presentation of chart monoids descends the map as well as the objects.

items.name: Vertical log morphism
items.statement: A log morphism f:X→S is vertical if the cokernel of f-inverse M_S→M_X is a sheaf of groups. For integral chart monoids P→Q this says for each q some q' and p satisfy q+q'=phi(p), not the printed tautological equality.

items.name: Stability of verticality
items.statement: Vertical maps are closed under composition and pullback; their rigid generic fibres have trivial relative characteristic monoids where the base log structure becomes trivial. The chart condition is invariant under quotient by units.

items.statement: For a nonarchimedean field K, endow Spf(O_K) with the log structure associated to O_K\{0}→O_K; k^0 is its pullback to the residue field, retaining the value monoid. No noetherian or discrete-value assumption is implicit here.

items.name: Generic-unit description of semistable log structure
items.statement: On a semistable formal model the canonical log structure is O_X intersected with the units on its generic fibre, making the stated forgetful functor fully faithful. In equal characteristic p invert a uniformizer, not p=0.

items.name: Semistable log points with sharp value monoid
items.statement: For a sharp integral multiplicative monoid Gamma and a nonidentity gamma, define the log point over k by 1↦1 and other elements↦0. A gamma-semistable object has standard normal-crossing charts with delta such that gamma is a positive power of delta. Sharpness and gamma nonunit are essential to the displayed construction.

items.statement: A colimit-preserving functor out of logFDA(S) is determined by its values on representables satisfying strict-étale hyperdescent, A1-invariance and Tate invertibility; natural transformations descend through the same localization.

items.statement: Kummer-étale or log-étale descent and the interval (P1,infinity) impose additional relations not included in Definition2.11. Vertical log-smooth objects over divisible value groups become polystable log-étale locally under ALPT18 Theorem5.2.16; this is a separate imported result.

items.name: Compact generation and pullback for log motives

items.name: Monoidal product of representable log motives
items.statement: The motivic categories are symmetric monoidal, with Q_S(X) tensor Q_S(X') equivalent to Q_S(X×_S X'); base change is monoidal. The second factor must be X', correcting Remark2.17.

items.name: Fine logarithmic special-fibre equivalence

items.name: Section-preserving log-smooth neighbourhood contraction

items.name: Positive pushforward detects top cohomology
items.statement: For a map h:Z→Y between projective smooth varieties over the algebraically closed base, with Z geometrically irreducible of dimension d and h_*[Z] a positive d-cycle, pullback H^(2d)(Y)→H^(2d)(Z) is nonzero. items.name: Full-dimensional image gives a positive cycle
items.statement: For proper h from a geometrically irreducible d-dimensional variety, if its scheme-theoretic image has dimension d then h_*[Z] is a positive multiple of the image cycle. The degree is nonzero and invertible in rational coefficients.

items.name: Top-degree trace for geometrically irreducible varieties
items.statement: For a geometrically irreducible d-dimensional variety with the stated realization/compact-support axioms, the top compact-support trace has rank one. items.name: Totally ramified invariance of good-reduction motives
items.statement: Let L be the completion of an algebraic extension of the complete discretely valued K in §3.1. items.name: Unramified descent and geometric generation
items.statement: Good-reduction motives satisfy the unramified étale descent in Proposition3.23(3), and over the completed algebraic closure they generate all rigid motives. Descending a compact object requires a finite extension; it need not have good reduction over the original field.

items.name: Module presentation over the nearby-fibre algebra
items.statement: The generic-fibre adjunction identifies RigDA^gr(K) with modules over chi(1) in DA(k). A choice of uniformizer identifies chi(1) with 1⊕1(−1)[−1]; for the compatible ramification choice the map has diagonal entries 1,e, hence is invertible rationally.

items.statement: The good-reduction category and its unramified colimit supply a K0^nr-model of overconvergent de Rham cohomology and its Frobenius; the arithmetic good-reduction realization has K0 coefficients. items.statement: For finite unramified K0/Q_p with residue cardinality q=p^a, an invertible semilinear Frobenius module is pure of integer weight w when every eigenvalue of phi^a is an algebraic Weil q-number of weight w. items.name: Nonzero top-degree comparison
items.statement: The ambient toric class pulls nontrivially to Z' by positivity of the alteration's image cycle. The commutative square therefore forces alpha^(2d) nonzero. Concluding it is an isomorphism requires both source and target top groups to have rank one.

items.name: Splitting a multiplicative Poincaré-duality map
items.statement: For graded cohomology algebras with perfect d-dimensional pairings, a multiplicative map inducing an isomorphism on their one-dimensional top groups has a left inverse in every degree: take the adjoint in complementary degree and normalize the top trace scalar. Require equivariance of pairings and multiplication for a (phi,N)-equivariant splitting.

items.name: Toric complete-intersection p-adic weight–monodromy
items.statement: Theorem5.6 asserts that for a smooth scheme-theoretic complete intersection Y over C_p in a projective smooth toric variety, H_HK^i(Y^an) is quasi-pure of weight i. Its written splitting argument establishes this with geometric connectedness (and treats dimension zero separately); removing that extra condition is a recorded proof gap, not an assumed reduction to components.

items.name: Local-field form of the main result
items.statement: For the smooth proper complete intersections over a p-adic local field in Theorem1.2, the normalized geometric Hyodo–Kato statement yields the stated p-adic weight–monodromy conjecture for each cohomological degree. Retain the same connectedness/proof-scope gate; Theorem5.6 itself does not assume descent from C_p to Q_p-bar.

items.name: Prime-to-p realization of the motivic argument
items.statement: With the rational motivic ell-adic realization for ell different from p and its cup products/duality, the same tube–tilt–alteration argument gives the scheme-theoretic complete-intersection case of Scholze's theorem. It does not broaden the motivic tube theorem to arbitrary set-theoretic intersections.

items.name: Complete intersection need not be connected
items.statement: The smooth divisor cut by X_0 X_1 in O(2,0) on P1×P1 is the disjoint union of two P1 fibres. It is a positive-dimensional scheme-theoretic hypersurface but disconnected; SGA2 XII3.5's ampleness hypothesis cannot be omitted. A componentwise replacement for the main proof remains to be supplied.

items.statement: Choose the uniformizer p of K0 and hence chi(1)≃1⊕1(−1)[−1]. Base change of chi(1)-modules along the chosen projection to 1 defines Psi:RigDA^gr(K)→DA(k). Over arbitrary perfect k the augmentation is chosen, not unique; uniqueness holds when k is algebraic over F_p.

items.statement: For compact good-reduction rigid motives, Psi carries a natural map N:Psi M→Psi M(−1), giving the ind-nilpotent monodromy/comodule enhancement DA(k)_N. A change of ramification normalization scales N. The full construction uses Ayoub's nearby cycles or BGV, not only a graded-vector-space operator.

items.statement: On a stable monoidal infinity-category, specify a retract-closed additive tensor-closed heart with connective mapping spectra which generates every object by finitely many shifts and cofibres. items.name: Chow heart of geometric motives
items.statement: The Karoubi-closed additive category generated by motives of smooth proper k-varieties with balanced Tate shifts is the heart of the bounded Chow weight structure on compact DA(k). Retain the rational coefficient and alteration hypotheses of the cited motivic weight-structure theorem.

items.statement: Images under xi of the Chow generators form the heart P_K of a bounded weight structure on compact good-reduction motives. Compute mapping spectra via chi(1)=1⊕1(−1)[−1] to prove connectivity; the induced homotopy heart is equivalent to the Chow heart.

items.name: Orthogonal purity degenerates the weight spectral sequence
items.statement: If the realizations of heart objects lie in the stipulated pure orthogonal abelian subcategories, higher differentials vanish and the weight spectral sequence degenerates at E2. The resulting graded realization factors through the weight complex with the filtration indexing of A.8.

items.name: Frobenius and weights on rational overconvergent de Rham
items.statement: The K0-valued overconvergent de Rham realization has Frobenius. When k is finite, purity on Chow objects supplies the functorial weight filtration by A.8; do not extend finite-field weights without a finite-field descent hypothesis.

items.statement: Apply the weight-complex functor to motivic N, carefully translating twist by (−1) into the balanced heart twist and a cohomological shift by two. After realization, N lowers the weight index by two with the associated Tate twist; boundedness gives nilpotence.

items.name: Stupid weight structure on bounded complexes
items.statement: For an additive category A (with the idempotent-completion convention needed for the heart), bounded chain complexes carry the standard weight structure with A in degree zero. In the monoidal case require the compatible tensor structure rather than invent one on every additive category.
